name: George Lane Pringle

death.place: road near his farm, Huntington Twp., Luzerne Co., PA

events.title: Killed by lightning
events.place: near Wilkes-Barre (road by his Huntington Twp. farm), PA
events.description: Struck and killed by lightning during a severe thunderstorm while walking along the road near a farm he owned in Huntington Twp. (Harvey). Reported nationally the next day: 'George L. Pringle, an old and prominent resident of Kingston, was struck by lightning on the roadway and killed' (Evening Star, Washington, 20 Mar 1886).

bioAdditions: George Lane Pringle was a twin of Caroline, born 20 May 1822 to Thomas Pringle and Elizabeth Harvey. He was probably named for the Rev. George Lane, the Methodist preacher who had married his aunt. He moved with the family to Kingston in 1837 and farmed there all his life. He never married. On 19 Mar 1886, in a severe thunderstorm, he was killed by lightning while walking on the road near a farm he owned in Huntington Twp. (S1). The next day the Washington Evening Star carried the news among its telegraph items (S2).
